candidates.name: Sick Sinus Syndrome
support_spans: The rhythm strip demonstrated gradual slowing of the sinus rate and atrioventricular conduction followed by complete atrioventricular block.
candidates.why: The patient's ECG and Holter monitor recording show abnormalities in the sinus rate and atrioventricular conduction, which are characteristic of Sick Sinus Syndrome.

candidates.name: Neurocardiogenic Syncope
support_spans: Recording showed a 23.8-second ventricular asystole during syncope.
